overrides.summary: A retail sales analysis case study of D-Mart data — cleaned and aggregated with Python (Pandas, NumPy) and explored through an interactive dashboard of categories and margins.
description: Supermarket chains generate large volumes of point-of-sale data, but store and category managers need a few clear answers: what sells, where margins sit and how categories trend.
This case study cleans and aggregates D-Mart sales data with Python (Pandas and NumPy) and presents it in an interactive React dashboard for exploring categories and margins.

features.title: Python data pipeline
features.desc: Pandas and NumPy to clean, normalise and aggregate the raw sales records.

features.title: Category drill-downs
features.desc: Explore sales by department and product category.

features.title: Margin views
features.desc: Compare categories by margin to see where profit actually comes from.

features.title: Interactive dashboard
features.desc: A React front end for exploring the results.

challenge: Retail chains produce huge volumes of point-of-sale data, while managers need a handful of clear answers about categories, margins and trends.
